selection_basis: B4 parameter-gradient Monte Carlo diagnostic on eight fixed 32-context train minibatches; no final/common panel or external audit used.

diagnostic_evidence.clipping: No sampled probe gradient exceeded norm 1.0 in the measured batches; clipping does not explain this observed difference.

hypothesis: Increasing sampled reward draws per context reduces estimator noise and may improve exact objective optimization; relevance improvement is not assumed.
alternative_explanations: Three training seeds remain a small algorithm-level sample.
Gradient probes cover eight fixed minibatches and two actor states, not the full train distribution.
Sampled and exact optimization can diverge through stochastic minibatch/sampling paths, finite updates, or proxy-relevance alignment.

fixed: same residual head architecture (32 hidden), feature scaler, support K=500, full catalog 20k, same frozen actor and optimized RM/reward scale, beta=0.3, batch contexts=32, learning rate=0.001, seeds 17/42/73, exactly 6000 updates, same train/development caches, full feedback features.
controls.exact_control: exact_expected_reward at beta=0.3, same architecture, seeds, fixed 6000 updates and data; sample count is not used by exact objective.
controls.checkpoint_rule: last.pt at update 6000 is primary; best.pt from pre-registered development exact-objective and 2% guard rule reported separately. If best is step 0, mark identity fallback, not trained checkpoint.

primary_outcomes: Development user-macro NDCG@10; paired user bootstrap CI for mean-across-seed policy differences after averaging the three fixed-seed user scores.
Development support-weighted exact objective J, analytic gap, KL(q||q*) and KL(q||p), plus training wall time.
secondary_outcomes: Retrospective final 710 and common open 6655 full-catalog NDCG/Recall as descriptive only after all branch checkpoints are frozen.
Train diagnostics and positive-new/repeat/support slices with n and user-bootstrap intervals.
Proxy expectation and KL versus NDCG plot; audit is descriptive only and not used for selection.
statistical_rule: Report per-seed values, seed mean/min/max/SD, paired user 95% bootstrap CIs (2000 draws) after user-level seed averaging; do not treat seeds as users. Report dev 2% guard separately; no multiplicity correction is claimed and all contrasts are exploratory.

fit_budget.hard_stop: No branch computation beyond remaining new-stage cap, remaining known total-stop threshold, or this branch allocation; include cache loading, preprocessing, inline dev evaluation, final evaluation, and plots.

explicitly_not_selected: No RM/affinity branch is registered: C improved RM-dev user-macro MAE over same-split panel_tools.1 control by 0.003133 (95% user-bootstrap CI [0.001827, 0.004501]), but this is a modest proxy prediction result, without a policy/relevance comparison; B5 showed current head representability of the proxy correction (dev weighted R2 about 0.771). Do not infer it should improve relevance.
